name: englobe-ams
description: Englobe AMS monorepo — React/Vite PWA (app/), TypeScript API (server/), shared wire contract (packages/contracts/), versioned migrations (db/).
//: Deliberately NOT an npm workspaces root. app/ and server/ each keep their own package-lock.json and their own node_modules, which is what the two CI workflows and every existing command already assume; converting them would regenerate three lockfiles to gain a name-based import that a relative path already provides. packages/contracts/ is type-only and has no runtime dependency, so both sides reach it by path. Revisit when a package here needs real dependencies of its own.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:contracts && npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix app run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix app run test
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
